reviews.text:
I want to emphasize that I was delighted with my visit to have my dog's nails trimmed. He's usually very aggressive and even attacks me when I try to do it at home, to the point that I didn't dare introduce him to anyone. But in the end, it went incredibly well; I was shocked! They reassured my dog ​​and trimmed his paws without charging extra. Now that I feel my dog ​​is comfortable with them, I won't be afraid to come back for regular nail trims.

Don't rely on the reviews; every dog ​​reacts differently, and it also depends on the groomer, as there are several. (I've had two grooming sessions in the past and never had any problems; my dog ​​was always very happy and excited to see me with his new haircut.) You have to try it for yourself :)

Bad experience on June 2nd, 2026 for my dog ​​and me (a small Griffon dog supposedly unmanageable even though I was there to control him).
The groomer was incompetent; my dog ​​ended up half-shaved and with a botched haircut.
The worst part was having to pay 70 euros! Unfortunately, I was too nice to argue. All that just to take him to a competent groomer 🤬
Shaïma is amazing, very patient and gentle with my dog. I highly recommend her! 🥰🥰🥰🥰 …

A very warm welcome with a smile...
I received excellent advice for Milo, my Maltese. I sincerely recommend the groomer. I dealt with Anaïs, who was truly very kind and adorable with Milo.

I strongly advise against this groomer. The girl told me he wasn't well cared for and that it was animal abuse. I paid a €19.50 deposit + €55 = €74.50. I was leaving the shop when she called me to say there would be an extra €10-15 charge for the knots because they were damaging the clipper blades. I had to come back to get Baby Lucky; he was clinging to a doorknob, crying a lot, and very thirsty. I paid, and she told me it was the last time I'd bring him in. I replied that I wasn't going to bring him back 😱😱 She even shaved his tail into a plume! I'm furious 😡 Plus, she cut him!!!

A fantastic welcome, as always!

Rachid and his colleagues were once again very attentive and patient with my questions and hesitations. They offered excellent advice, always with the dog's well-being in mind.

They were able to adapt to each of our dogs, whether they were 12 years old or 2 or 3.
Rachid has been taking care of my Shih Tzus for a very long time, and I wanted to thank him for his empathy, kindness, and patience!
A very friendly person who knows how to handle fearful dogs. My little girl was in a terrible state; she's so beautiful I didn't even recognize her 🙏 Thank you …
I highly recommend this groomer. Kindness, humor, and a beautiful, clean dog.

Absolutely avoid this place for your dog's well-being!
My German Shepherd is usually groomed there for two hours because she's a large dog, with a price of €90. But strangely, they took over four hours to groom her, from 11:30 AM to 4:15 PM, and charged an extra fee. The so-called groomer was dismissive of us on the phone and in person, insisting we bring the extra fee. When we left, she acted very strangely.

I picked up my dog, who was parched and had diarrhea from fear. She's extremely traumatized, and I want an explanation.

Oddly enough, when we got home, she didn't have any diarrhea. She struggled to get up and climb the stairs for an hour.

I wouldn't wish this on any animal, and I'm taking my dog ​​to the vet this Monday, hoping she's okay.
